notes.title: The Sniper VR v1.1
notes.content:
This build has been long overdue, but its finally here with major fixes.
[list]
    [*]Resolved a bug that caused the weapons to disappear in some missions
    [*]Adjusted the Zoom In/Out sensitivity for better precision
    [*]Adjusted the drop clip button sensitivity to resolve reloading issues
[/list]
We've performed some under the hood optimization, so the game should run smoother.

Thank you for playing The Sniper VR! See you in the next update.

notes.title: Optimization and Weapon Stabilization fix
notes.content:
[h1] Weapon Stabilization bug has been squashed! [/h1]

We captured feedback from our players and have resolved many of the issues reported.  

[list]
    [*]A big one was our advanced stabilization system, there was a bug that caused issues for our Vive users, that bug has been taken care of, and the stabilization system is better then ever! Seriously is pretty cool!
    [*]A reloading bug was reported and has been resolved
    [*]We've performed some under the hood optimization, so the game should run smoother.
[/list]

Thank you for playing The Sniper VR! See you in the next update.

notes.title: Update v0.9.0 Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28375881/adf56f526f53612ab00bcdeb5d3fb394b0858074.png[/img]
[h1]Summary[/h1]
 
It's been a while but we’re finally back with a big update!  Details below
 
[h1]Highlight[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]2 new Levels[/b]
    [*]Level 8: Airport, take out enemies from the top of a flight control tower but be careful not to harm any civilians
    [*]Level 9: Military Base, lots of exciting new features in this level, we’ll leave it for the mission planning to go through
 [*]Updated the difficulty level throughout the game
 [*]Re-ordered the missions to ensure you’re not thrown into a hard mission from the start
 [*]Re-priced “The Sniper” rifle
 [*]Updated the visuals for all levels
 [*]Lots of UI changes
 [*]Squashed small bugs here and there
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new update and thanks for playing “The Sniper VR”!  See you in the next update.

notes.title: Two Handed Grip Release! Update v0.8.5
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
The community's feedback is clear, 2 handed controls were requested and 2 handed controls have now been delivered!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You can now grip the sniper with 2 hands
    [*]Stabilization system 2.0 is now available, allowing you to remove the VR shiver with one or two hands on the sniper by simply holding the trigger before shooting.
    [*]Make adjustment after stabilizing to get the perfect shot!
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]All levels have now been tweaked adjusting the difficulty
    [*]Teleportation areas have been tweaked
    [*]Minor bug fixes here and there
[/list]

Thank you for playing The Sniper VR! See you in the next update.

notes.title: Update v0.8.0 Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28375881/ee3ee97ad025c84c96eb61dc9aba5388e465166f.png[/img]
[h1]Summary[/h1]
We've been keeping an ear to the community and noticed that difficulty levels needed to be included, so that is exactly what we did.

We spent the last 2 days working hard on creating a new difficulty system to ensure the game is enjoyable to everyone!

In this release, we added 3 difficulty levels:
[list]
    [*]Easy - Which gives you 30% more ammo and allows you to kill the enemy with 3 shots to the body.
    [*]Regular - Only a head shot kills an enemy
    [*]Hard - Head-shot only and 30% less ammo than regular
[/list]

To make sure our dead-eye snipers don't feel cheated, we pumped up the reward of playing in harder difficulty.  Now you get 15% bonus on your score when playing on the hard mode.

Thank you for playing The Sniper VR! See you in the next update.
